method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Builds a focusable footer with backing/title and six perk entries. Text is localized directly for two entries and filled by bonus-credit, XP, gun-XP and merit injectors for the other four. It registers its class close callback, runs PostLoadFunc only when present, then returns the assembled widget. No purchase, grant or entitlement change is performed by these displayed text requests. Constructs CoD.Footer_IGRPerksList from the displayed menu/controller/layout arguments. Creates Backing as CoD.IGRPerksListBacking.new, Title as CoD.IGRPerksListTitle.new, IGRPerk4 as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new, IGRPerk as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new, IGRPerk3 as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new, IGRPerk2 as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new, IGRPerk6 as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new, IGRPerk5 as CoD.IGRPerkElement.new. Installs 1 event/action/override bindings; each callback keeps its captured controller/menu/widget references and executes only on its bound delivery. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.
